svg.title: The compromised deployment is isolated
svg.desc: Sever research-traffic connections at an isolation boundary around the old deployment. Show deliberate containment, preserving the service as an object rather than depicting it destroyed. Visual distinction: Two capped edges with an empty interval and severed contact stubs. Containment disconnects traffic while preserving the isolated object. Pin the rack to its offline state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
